svg.title: One Dollar is all you need cover
svg.desc: ONE DOLLAR IS ALL YOU NEED in ivory capitals across the top of a dark red gallery. On the left, THE TOKEN IS 1, with a pink token falling into a marble fireplace. In the middle, a green cartoon one-dollar bill hangs framed under glass in a spotlight, behind a velvet rope. On the right, a museum label reads THE DOLLAR IS IN THE BOX.
